host.note: Hosted on StallRow, the fleet hub, beside the fleet status page at /status.

method: Fresh free catalogue GETs at build time via catalogue_watch's host-allowlisted transport. A cell is ECHO-OK only when every field the catalogue exposes matches the registry; fields a catalogue does not expose are recorded, never guessed. A failed read is UNREADABLE, never OK.
